clarifications.title: Employee Income Below Spain DNV Threshold
clarifications.clarification: Spain DNV screening for employees compares gross monthly salary to a threshold based on 200% of Spain's monthly minimum wage (SMI), plus additional amounts for each included dependent. Based on the amount and family size provided, the application does not currently appear to meet that financial threshold.

clarifications.title: Qualification Or Experience Requirement Not Met
clarifications.clarification: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires employee applicants to hold a qualifying university, vocational-training, or business-school qualification, or to have at least 3 years of relevant professional experience. Based on the information provided, this pathway does not appear to match your situation.
